title: Autocorrelation-Realization CA on the 167-Cycle
novelty_claim: Use a 1D cyclic cellular automaton as a generator for the specific missing length-167, weight-80 support required by the current order-668 cyclic reduction, rather than using CA as a generic matrix-search heuristic.
closest_prior_art: Constantine and Constantine (2025) on the exact 167/80 cyclic obstruction
CA combinatorial-design and bent-function generation cited in the local scout outputs
differentiation: Targets the exact unresolved obstruction identified by the scout outputs instead of a full 668x668 search from scratch.
Uses CA rule/seed space only as a proposal family for weight-80 supports and holds it to matched direct-search baselines on the same symmetry-reduced space.
Rejects any CA family that collapses into classical circulant or Williamson-like orbits.
easiest_falsifier: Reconstruct the exact periodic-autocorrelation target and compare a modest matched-budget CA sweep against direct search on the same weight-80 support space; if CA does not beat the baseline, kill the branch.
evidence_plan: Recover the exact 167/80 target from the current cyclic reduction.
Run at least one solved same-template positive control before touching p = 167.
Measure exact-hit rate or closest-target rate against a same-space direct-search baseline and audit reachability plus equivalence collapse.
budget_envelope: Small: one target-reconstruction pass, one positive control, one matched-budget CA-vs-direct baseline sweep, then go/no-go.

title: Defect-Transport CA Lift From the 64-Modular 668 Seed
novelty_claim: Use cellular automata as a Hadamard-specific defect-repair layer on the published 64-modular order-668 seed, with exact certification kept outside the CA.
closest_prior_art: Simulated annealing, quantum annealing, and QAOA-style Hadamard search methods listed in the scout outputs
Cellular-automaton decoder and local-repair paradigms in adjacent fields
differentiation: Starts from the best known near-solution instead of a cold start and operates on a defect graph rather than raw matrix entries.
Claims novelty only if the CA encoding uses Hadamard-specific invariants and outperforms same-neighborhood non-CA local search.
Treats modulus lifting as the benchmark, not generic energy reduction.
easiest_falsifier: If the same update budget cannot lift solved smaller instances by one modulus step, or cannot improve the 64-modular 668 seed beyond modulus 64, kill the branch.
evidence_plan: Reconstruct the published 64-modular seed and its residual defect pattern.
Benchmark CA updates against same-seed greedy or annealed local search on solved smaller lift tasks.
Promote only if the CA shows a real modulus-lift or exact-certification advantage under matched controls.
budget_envelope: Medium-small: one defect reconstruction pass, one smaller-order lift ladder, one same-seed 668 attempt, then stop unless modulus improves.

title: Orbit-Representative Path CA on Canonical 167-Supports
novelty_claim: Run CA on canonical path or run-length encodings of weight-80 supports so the dynamics act on orbit representatives rather than raw 167-bit strings.
closest_prior_art: Path/run-length structure around the cyclic 167 obstruction described in the scout outputs
Automaton-style pruning ideas discussed in the bridge memo
differentiation: Keeps the target tied to the 167/80 obstruction while changing the state representation to orbit-aware tokens.
Only remains novel if the CA dynamics do more than encode a branch-and-bound or SAT prefilter.
Must beat a baseline that uses the same compressed representation without CA dynamics.
easiest_falsifier: If the compressed-state CA cannot outperform a non-CA search on the same canonical representation, or spends most of its time outside valid canonical states, kill it.
evidence_plan: Define canonical path representatives for weight-80 subsets of Z_167.
Construct a matched non-CA baseline on the same compressed representation.
Check whether the CA gains any target-hit rate or pruning advantage beyond representation alone.
budget_envelope: Small reserve budget only after H1 and H2 fail for representation-specific reasons.
